format: Chaos Rising (CRI): cards not already in the pool. H and later = Standard; G = Expanded.

attacks.name: Surprise Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. On tails, this attack does nothing.

abilities.name: Exoskeleton
abilities.text: This Pokémon takes 20 less damage from attacks (after Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Rumbling Bees
attacks.text: Does 110 damage for each of your Beedrill and Beedrill ex in play.

attacks.name: Chomp Whole
attacks.text: Does 80 more damage if your opponent's Active Pokémon has no Retreat Cost.

attacks.name: Leafy Charge
attacks.text: Find a Basic Grass Energy card in your deck and attach it to this Pokémon. Shuffle your deck.

abilities.name: Needly Armor
abilities.text: If this Pokémon is in the Active Spot and is damaged by an attack from your opponent's Pokémon (even if it's Knocked Out), put 3 damage counters on the Attacking Pokémon for each Grass Energy attached to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Impound
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Singe
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon becomes Burned.

attacks.name: Nine-Tailed Transfer
attacks.text: Move all damage counters from 1 of your Benched Pokémon to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Flames of Revival
attacks.text: Put up to 3 Basic Pokémon from your discard pile onto your Bench.

attacks.name: Bright Wing
attacks.text: Discard a Fire Energy from this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Flamethrower
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Ferocious Bellow
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, attacks used by the Defending Pokémon do 50 less damage (before Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Fiery Big Bang
attacks.text: Does 10 less damage for each damage counter on this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Jet of Ink
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, if the Defending Pokémon tries to attack, your opponent flips 2 coins. If either is tails, the attack doesn't happen.

attacks.name: Tantrum
attacks.text: This Pokémon becomes Confused.

attacks.name: Pleasing Present
attacks.text: Each player may attach up to 3 Basic Energy cards from their hand to their Pokémon however they like. Your opponent goes first.

attacks.name: Shoot Through
attacks.text: Also does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon (no Weakness or Resistance for Benched Pokémon).

attacks.name: Reflect Energy
attacks.text: Move an Energy from this Pokémon to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Collect
attacks.text: Draw a card.

attacks.name: Summoning Jutsu
attacks.text: Find up to 3 Pokémon in your deck, show them to your opponent and put them into your hand. Shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Iceberg Breaker
attacks.text: Discard the top 6 cards of your deck. Does 60 damage for each Basic Water Energy card discarded this way.

attacks.name: Critical Slash
attacks.text: If this attack's damage Knocks Out your opponent's Pokémon, prevent all damage and effects of attacks done to this Pokémon during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Boundless Power
attacks.text: This Pokémon can't attack during your next turn.

attacks.name: Thunder Wave
attacks.text: Flip a coin. On heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon becomes Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Disconnect
attacks.text: Your opponent can't play Item cards from their hand during their next turn.

attacks.name: Minor Errand-Running
attacks.text: Find up to 2 Basic Energy cards in your deck, show them to your opponent and put them into your hand. Shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Sky Return
attacks.text: Put this Pokémon and everything attached to it into your hand.

attacks.name: Genome Charge
attacks.text: Find up to 2 Basic Psychic Energy cards in your deck and attach them to this Pokémon. Shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Psychic
attacks.text: Does 20 more damage for each Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Psy Protection
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks from Pokémon that have an Ability.

attacks.name: Psyspeed
attacks.text: You may draw until you have 5 cards in your hand.

attacks.name: Gentle Light
attacks.text: Heal 30 damage from every Pokémon in play (yours and your opponent's).

attacks.name: Eternity Bloom
attacks.text: Find up to 4 Basic Psychic Energy cards in your deck and attach them to your Benched Pokémon however you like. Shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Buddy Attack
attacks.text: Does 60 more damage if you played Emma from your hand this turn.

attacks.name: Tricky Steps
attacks.text: You may move an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon to 1 of their Benched Pokémon.

abilities.name: Spiteful Evolution
abilities.text: Once during your turn (not your first turn), you may evolve this Pokémon with a card from your hand that evolves from it. If you do, put 2 damage counters on the evolved Pokémon.

attacks.name: Cursed Roots
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, Energy can't be attached from their hand to the Defending Pokémon.

attacks.name: Overwhelming Pain
attacks.text: Does 10 more damage for each damage counter on all of your opponent's Pokémon.

attacks.name: Horrifying Rondo
attacks.text: Does 50 more damage for each of your Benched Pokémon that has damage counters on it.

attacks.name: Ghostly Touch
attacks.text: Discard a random card from your opponent's hand.

attacks.name: Geo Storm
attacks.text: Does 30 damage for each Psychic Energy attached to all of your Pokémon.

attacks.name: Trials and Trip-ulations
attacks.text: Find up to 2 Transformation Tome cards in your deck, show them to your opponent and put them into your hand. Shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Rock Hurl
attacks.text: Resistance doesn't apply to this attack's damage.

attacks.name: No Reprieve
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon's attacks do 120 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon (before Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Smashing Headbutt
attacks.text: Discard 2 Energy from this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Continuous Spin
attacks.text: Flip coins until you get tails. Does 30 damage for each heads.

attacks.name: Devolution Ray
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is evolved, devolve it: put its highest Stage Evolution card into your opponent's hand.

attacks.name: Gale Slash
attacks.text: Does 150 more damage if this Pokémon has no damage counters on it.

attacks.name: Supersonic
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon becomes Confused.

attacks.name: Covert Flight
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks from Basic Pokémon.

abilities.name: Poison Point
abilities.text: If this Pokémon is in the Active Spot and is damaged by an attack from your opponent's Pokémon (even if it's Knocked Out), the Attacking Pokémon becomes Poisoned.

attacks.name: Venoshock
attacks.text: Does 50 more damage if your opponent's Active Pokémon is Poisoned.

attacks.name: Smash Turn
attacks.text: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Corner
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Strong Bite
attacks.text: Does 140 more damage if this Pokémon has a Pokémon Tool attached.

attacks.name: Acid Spray
attacks.text: Flip a coin. On heads, discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

abilities.name: Gloomy Garbage
abilities.text: Attacks used by your opponent's Active Pokémon that has a Pokémon Tool attached do 20 less damage (before Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Guard Press
attacks.text: This Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks during your opponent's next turn (after Weakness and Resistance).

abilities.name: Startling Drop
abilities.text: During your opponent's turn, if this card is discarded from your deck by an effect of your opponent's attack, Ability, Item or Supporter, discard the top 8 cards of your opponent's deck.

attacks.name: Special Whip
attacks.text: Does 70 more damage if this Pokémon has any Special Energy attached.

abilities.name: Metal Road
abilities.text: Once during your turn, when this Pokémon moves from your Bench to the Active Spot, you may move any amount of Metal Energy from your other Pokémon to it.

attacks.name: Power Tackle
attacks.text: This Pokémon can't attack during your next turn.

attacks.name: Corrosive Liquid
attacks.text: Discard every Pokémon Tool and Special Energy from all of your opponent's Pokémon.

attacks.name: Pernicious Poison
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon becomes Poisoned. During Pokémon Checkup, put 16 damage counters on it instead of 1.

attacks.name: Absorb
attacks.text: Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Target Together
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon and flip a coin for each of your Pokémon in play with "Tauros" in its name. Does 50 damage to that Pokémon for each heads (no Weakness or Resistance for Benched Pokémon).

attacks.name: Snap Inspection
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. If any are heads, your opponent shows you their hand; for each heads, choose a card from it and shuffle it into their deck.

cards.name: Adversity Policy
cards.text: If the Pokémon this card is attached to is Weak to the type of your opponent's Active Pokémon, is in the Active Spot, and is damaged by an attack from your opponent's Pokémon (even if it's Knocked Out), draw 3 cards.

cards.name: Ange Floette
cards.text: You can play this card only by discarding a Prism Tower in play, and you can play it on the same turn you played Prism Tower. Each Mega Floette ex in play (yours and your opponent's) gets +150 HP.

cards.name: Emma
cards.text: Your opponent shows you their hand. Draw a card for each Pokémon in it.

cards.name: Great Haul Net
cards.text: Choose 1 or both: shuffle up to 3 Water Pokémon from your discard pile into your deck, and/or shuffle up to 3 Basic Water Energy cards from your discard pile into your deck.

cards.name: Roxie's Performance
cards.text: During your opponent's next turn, their Poisoned Pokémon can't retreat (including Pokémon that become Poisoned later).

cards.name: Transformation Tome
cards.text: Play 2 Transformation Tome cards at once (the effect happens once). Switch a Basic Pokémon in your discard pile with 1 of your Basic Pokémon in play. Attached cards, damage counters, Special Conditions, time in play and other effects stay on the new Pokémon.

cards.name: Bubbly Water Energy
cards.text: Provides Water Energy. The Water Pokémon this card is attached to recovers from all Special Conditions and can't be affected by them.

cards.name: Magnetic Metal Energy
cards.text: Provides Metal Energy. The Metal Pokémon this card is attached to has no Retreat Cost.

cards.name: Nitro Fire Energy
cards.text: Provides Fire Energy. If an effect of an attack used by the Fire Pokémon it's attached to discards this card, put it into your hand after the attack.
